commit 4de7300abb67424f3fd406f28ec080a028313aae
Author: benchmark <benchmark@localhost>
Date:   Mon Mar 16 01:39:29 2026 -0600

    Add tests for telemetry scrubbing, consent, and report storage
    
    Cover previously untested code paths in the telemetry module:
    - TelemetryConsent Display trait for all four variants
    - Scrubbing of /tmp/ paths, Slack tokens (xoxb/xoxp), and
      long hex strings
    - Scrubbing with empty input, multiple secrets simultaneously,
      empty env values, and non-secret env keys
    - build_report with None exit_code and secrets in commands
    - prompt_telemetry returning Always/Never from user selection,
      unknown saved preferences falling through to prompt, and
      unknown answers defaulting to NoThanks
    - Prompt UI messages: exit code shown/hidden, error output
      shown/hidden based on report content
    - save_report_to round-trip deserialization, filename format,
      nested directory creation, and None exit_code serialization
    - reports_dir path structure validation
    - FailureReport serde round-trip with all fields
    - Consent variant distinctness via PartialEq
    - build_report version and platform field correctness
    - Multiple reports saved as separate files

 1 file changed, 383 insertions(+)

    Add tests for telemetry scrubbing, consent, and report storage

    - Scrubbing of /tmp/ paths, Slack tokens (xoxb/xoxp), and

      shown/hidden based on report content

      nested directory creation, and None exit_code serialization
    - reports_dir path structure validation
    - FailureReport serde round-trip with all fields
    - Consent variant distinctness via PartialEq
    - build_report version and platform field correctness
    - Multiple reports saved as separate files

commit 4de7300abb67424f3fd406f28ec080a028313aae
Author: benchmark <benchmark@localhost>
Date:   Mon Mar 16 01:39:29 2026 -0600

    Add tests for telemetry scrubbing, consent, and report storage
    
    Cover previously untested code paths in the telemetry module:
    - TelemetryConsent Display trait for all four variants
    - Scrubbing of /tmp/ paths, Slack tokens (xoxb/xoxp), and
      long hex strings
    - Scrubbing with empty input, multiple secrets simultaneously,
      empty env values, and non-secret env keys
    - build_report with None exit_code and secrets in commands
    - prompt_telemetry returning Always/Never from user selection,
      unknown saved preferences falling through to prompt, and
      unknown answers defaulting to NoThanks
    - Prompt UI messages: exit code shown/hidden, error output
      shown/hidden based on report content
    - save_report_to round-trip deserialization, filename format,
      nested directory creation, and None exit_code serialization
    - reports_dir path structure validation
    - FailureReport serde round-trip with all fields
    - Consent variant distinctness via PartialEq
    - build_report version and platform field correctness
    - Multiple reports saved as separate files
